text_block_list.text:
On the platform after getting off the 
train on my way back from running errands—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Express across the platform from where I 
got off... Express across the platform—

—Katsuragi Ace walked straight toward me 
without noticing I was there...!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Ah, sorry about that! I was lost in 
thought...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ah, sorry about her! Ace-san's head is 
totally full of transfer details right 
now.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Wait, that totally threw off my route! 
Ummm, let's see...!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"Limited express across the platform from 
where I got off"— ...That's right, isn't 
it, Palmer?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Close, but it's the "Rapid Express," not 
"Limited Express"! I sent you notes on the 
route too, so just look at that if you get 
lost.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that's a lifesaver! With this, I might 
actually make it to our meetup without 
being late...!

text_block_list.name: Announcement
text_block_list.text:
"The train is arriving—please stand behind 
the yellow line."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Alright, have a safe trip♪ Call me right 
away if there's anything you don't get!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... Thanks for seeing me off! I'm 
gonna go have a blast!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ace-san's really bad with train transfers, 
y'know. She's literally ridden back and 
forth between the first and last stops 
before~. Hope she'll be okay today, but—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Huh... That's a call from Ace-san. —Hello?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Eh, yeah... Understood! I'll head right 
back!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Palmer! What just happened here?! Why am I 
back at the original station~?!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
I could've sworn I took the express that 
was stopped "over there" when I got 
off...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Over there... You mean you went up the 
stairs and boarded the train on the 
platform in the back? So close~! You were 
supposed to board "across the platform"!
choice_data_list: You just had to wait on the same platform.

You just had to wait on the same platform, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Gwaaahhh!! I messed up again~~!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Dammit, city trains are way too confusing! 
Do we really need this many tracks?!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
It was like this the very first time I 
rode the train after coming here too... I 
went out to get used to the city, and then 
had no idea how to get back...!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
The announcements were full of line names 
I'd never heard of so they made no sense, 
and I blew right past the station I meant 
to get off at!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
I managed to get back somehow, but they 
ended up labeling me a problem child who 
broke curfew on her very first day in the 
dorms...!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
At least this time was better since I 
didn't actually get lost...

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
But if things keep going like this, won't 
I end up stranded on a train one day?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's got stuff they're not great at. 
That's why we gotta help each other out in 
times like these!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
If you're cool with it, Ace-san, I'll go 
with you all the way to your destination!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: P-Palmer...!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Ngh...! You really are the single greatest 
roommate ever...!
choice_data_list: Will you make it in time for your meetup?

I totally get why trains can be 
overwhelming.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Oh right...! Whoa, we only have 30 minutes 
left?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
It'll be fine! The next train is arriving 
already! As long as everything goes 
smoothly, you'll make it with plenty of 
time!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Back home we only had one train every 
hour...! Big cities are insane!!

Thanks to Mejiro Palmer, Katsuragi Ace 
didn't board the wrong train this time and 
managed to meet up with her friend!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
You too, Trainer?! Oh thank goodness! It's 
not just me!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Y'know that thing where the train line 
name suddenly changes halfway through the 
ride? That makes zero sense, right?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Ah, yeah, I kinda get that one!

Until the next train arrived, we had a 
blast bonding over relatable city-train 
struggles!
